title.zh: 关于 cookie 的一些总结

summary.en: What attributes should a cookie have? When a cookie has the HttpOnly attribute, it can only be sent over HTTP (or HTTPS) and can't be accessed by client-side JavaScript. This is an effective defense against cross-site scripting (XSS), because an attacker can't read an HttpOnly cookie by injecting malicious JavaScript.
